feed_summary: Founded in 2025 by Unit 8200 alumni, Tel Aviv-based Mave uses AI agents to investigate alerts across existing security stacks. The post Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave
